title: Renown in the clan war
changes: Every minute you hold a standard now earns you renown. Climb from Sworn to Shieldbearer, Standard-bearer, Banneret, Warlord and Hero of the Marches.
Your renown and the next rank show in the oath panel at any standard. The herald tells you when you reach a new rank.
Renown stays with your hero if you change clan.
